title: spawn_node type_name clones leak on parse-error exit paths
detail: A parse error on any line after a `spawn_node` returns `{}` from parse_demo, dropping the default-allocated type_name clones (and the dynamic slices) unfreed — the clones are new in this PR. Error-path-only, bounded short-lived CLI; determinism unaffected.
recommended_fix: In parse_demo, free d.nodes (each type_name + the slice) before every `return {}, ...` taken after spawn_node lines, or parse the demo into an arena and free once at exit.

title: spawn_node coordinates silently truncate i64 to i32 outside the i32 range
detail: parse_int returns i64; the `i32(x)` cast wraps values beyond ±2^31 silently (e.g. 3000000000 -> -1294967296), placing the node at a position the author never wrote. Deterministic but not fail-loud, unlike the unknown-type and parse-failure paths (same seed -> same topology still holds).
recommended_fix: Range-check x/y against i32 min/max in the parser and return the 'bad spawn_node position' error, or parse directly into i32.
